topic.title: RBI raises the repo rate: what it means for my loan EMI and FD

cta: Comment RATE if you have a floating loan
title: RBI hiked the repo rate. What changes for your FD?
description: The RBI raised the repo rate this month. Here is what a rate move can mean for a floating-rate loan and for a fixed deposit, using an assumed 7% FD rate on ₹5 lakh for 5 years. Rates are assumptions, not assured. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
